verdict.rationale: Oneleet's docs confirm it offers a customizable Trust Center that customers can set up, publish, and link from their landing page, so the core hosted trust center exists. Nothing in the evidence describes what it shows or how access is gated. Missing for 10: live control status on the trust center, display of certifications, reports gated behind a click-through NDA, any evidence that it shortens or pre-empts security reviews, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start

citations.quote: Once onboarded to the Oneleet platform, set up and publish your customizable Trust Center. You can add a link to the Trust Center on your Landing Page
set up and publish your customizable Trust Center. You can add a link to the Trust Center on your Landing Page to show your ongoing commitment to security.
